description: STATE HOUSE — Legislation introduced by Rep. Camille F.J. Vella-Wilkinson (D-Dist. 21, Warwick) and Sen. Melissa A. Murray (D-Dist. 24, Woonsocket, North Smithfield) to permit Alcoholics Anonymous and Narcotics Anonymous to hold meetings during a declared disaster emergency has become law….
paid_for_by: Paid for by Friends of Melissa Murray
title: Governor signs bill allowing AA/NA meetings during a state of emergency — Melissa Murray
